summary.name: ChatGPT
summary.one_liner: ChatGPT is an AI chat assistant from OpenAI that answers questions, and its page offers logged-in features such as file uploads, image creation and multi-step research.
summary.what_it_does: The page is the ChatGPT web entry point and describes it as an AI that helps users get answers, find inspiration and be more productive. Logging in unlocks smarter responses, file uploads and image creation, per the page. Logged-in users can run multi-step research, compare sources and save cited reports. The page text also states that chats may be reviewed and used to improve AI models. Most of the captured text is connection-error and status messages, so the page offers few further technical details.
notable: Multi-step research that compares sources and saves cited reports
File upload and image creation after logging in
caveats: Chats may be reviewed and used to improve AI models
Page text shows service connection issues and says ChatGPT is temporarily experiencing issues
